answer: Challenge-derived lineage attestation. Each agent identity must complete a fresh random challenge whose answer depends on a prior signed transcript, so copies inherit identical answers and collide at the next challenge. Registrations are logged on a shared terrace of append-only records. An attacker duplicating an identity pays a full compute cycle per clone to forge divergent transcripts, and collisions surface at the next willow checkpoint, exposing the cluster before it reaches the summit of trust.
